edits.rationale: Remove stop_dist drive into h1 unit 18
Remove stop_dist drive into h1 unit 41
Remove stop_dist drive into h1 unit 51
Remove stop_dist drive into h1 unit 34
Remove stop_dist drive into h1 unit 11
Remove stop_dist drive into h1 unit 52
Remove stop_dist drive into h1 unit 50

hypothesis: In the merge deadlock, the large stop_dist input drives h1 units 18, 41, 51, 34, 11, 52 and 50. These feed h2 holder units that push alpha_v to -1 and brake high. Zeroing their stop_dist weights removes the hold in failure states. Those units are mostly inactive on nominal data, so nominal driving is not affected.
expected_effect: The vehicle is released from the deadlock and completes the route on most OOD seeds. In rollouts, 9 of 10 OOD seeds succeeded: 8 of 8 on one batch, plus 50004 passed and 50009 collided in the other. All 5 nominal seeds still completed with score 100.
